# Evaluation results (auto-generated by `python main.py evaluate`)

## E1 Transaction categorisation

Train: 641 transactions (months 1-6). Test: 595 transactions (months 7-12), of which 158 are from merchants never seen in training.

| Model | Accuracy (all) | Seen merchants | Unseen merchants |
|---|---|---|---|
| naive_bayes (ours: text + amount/time + brand-dictionary hint) | 87.9% | 100.0% | 54.4% |
| naive_bayes without brand-dictionary hint | 79.5% | 99.3% | 24.7% |
| naive_bayes text only | 80.0% | 99.8% | 25.3% |
| keyword_rules (brand dictionary alone) | 54.1% | 56.1% | 48.7% |

Online learning (accuracy on the last 300 test transactions):

- no feedback: 87.7%
- 30% of errors corrected: 98.0%
- all errors corrected: 99.7%

![](outputs/e1_confusion_matrix.png)
![](outputs/e1_online_learning.png)

## E2 Anomaly / fraud detection

6043 test transactions over 5 seeds x 12 months, 125 anomalous.

| Detector | Precision@0.5 | Recall@0.5 | F1@0.5 | Avg precision | Flags raised |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ours | 0.78 | 0.83 | 0.81 | 0.73 | 133 |
| fixed_threshold | 0.24 | 0.66 | 0.35 | 0.18 | 342 |
| global_zscore | 0.29 | 0.61 | 0.40 | 0.23 | 260 |

Recall of our detector by anomaly type: burst 65%, duplicate 100%, large_amount 80%, unknown_night 100%

![](outputs/e2_anomaly_pr_curve.png)
